title: Target Evidence Review
description: Resolve a disease and candidate targets, then compare source-linked Open Targets evidence through a researcher-approved workflow.

tools.name: target_evidence_preflight
tools.description: Resolve one disease and up to eight candidate target symbols or Ensembl IDs in Open Targets without creating an analysis output.

candidates.description: One to eight target symbols or Ensembl IDs separated by commas, semicolons, or new lines.

tools.name: target_evidence_compare
tools.description: Retrieve, normalize, rank, and persist an approved Open Targets comparison with evidence types, tractability, pathways, safety signals, drugs, publications, and provenance.
